architecture_scope.text: Configuration hall_icp_neutralizer only (GR-16). Any other configuration, including hall_c1_reference, is refused (MODEL_ERROR).

One Hall accelerator (H-1) and one downstream 13.56 MHz RF/ICP electron source / neutralizer. Flight conventional hollow cathode: NONE. C1: GROUND_REFERENCE_ONLY; it is never a node, a load, a boundary or a case configuration of this model (A9.19, A9.20, A9.29 sec. 15).

Supply modes AIR_PRIMARY and XE_CONTINGENCY are both represented as case inputs. The thermal equations are gas-agnostic; the mode changes the interface loads. NON_FIRING is a case state for standby / cold cases (interface discharge and RF keys zero by registration, never by default).

nodes.rule: Lumped, isothermal nodes. Every node and link is registered; there is no default node, link, conductance or property. A REQUIRED node must be present in every case. A CONDITIONAL node is present only when the registered design has the part; when absent, every load mapped to it must be re-mapped by a registered partition (else INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE).
nodes.thermal_mass_representation: C_i(T) = sum over parts p of m_p * c_p,p(T) [J/K]. Stored-energy change H_i(T) - H_i(T_a) = integral from T_a to T of C_i(T') dT', evaluated exactly for the registered c_p form (piecewise-linear table or polynomial). Masses come from registered geometry / BOM records (SC-WP-07), c_p(T) from registered material records with a temperature validity range. A node with C_i = 0 is allowed only as a registered massless series node (an algebraic constraint in transients).

equations.notation: i, j: solved nodes; b: boundaries; k, l: surfaces; e: radiation enclosures; T in K; Q in W (positive into the receiving node); sigma = 5.670374419e-8 W m^-2 K^-4 (CODATA 2022, exact; registered source nist_codata_sigma).

items.name: transient node energy balance (enthalpy form)
items.form: dH_i/dt = Q_src,i(t, T) + Q_tc,i(t) + Q_env,i(t) + sum_j Q_cond,j->i + sum_b Q_bc,b->i + Q_rad,i
items.terms: Q_src,i interface deposition (E-07, E-09); Q_tc,i registered thermal-control dissipation (Q_thermal_control_W); Q_env,i absorbed environment (E-06); Q_cond conduction (E-03, E-04); Q_bc boundary links (E-08); Q_rad,i net radiative gain (E-05)
items.source: first law for a lumped body; lumped-capacitance method: Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, ch. 5 (verify V-01)

items.name: steady state
items.form: 0 = right-hand side of E-01 for every solved node (dH_i/dt = 0)

items.name: conduction through a registered material segment (Kirchhoff transform)
items.form: Q_cond,j->i = S_ij * (Theta_m(T_j) - Theta_m(T_i)), Theta_m(T) = integral from T* to T of k_m(T') dT'; S_ij = A / L (slab), 2 pi L / ln(r_o / r_i) (cylindrical shell) or a registered shape factor with its source
items.properties: exact for steady 1-D conduction with k(T); antisymmetric in (i, j), so the link conserves energy exactly; Theta_m evaluated exactly for the registered k(T) form
items.source: Kirchhoff transformation: Carslaw & Jaeger, Conduction of Heat in Solids, 2nd ed. (verify V-04); shape factors: Incropera & DeWitt ch. 3 (verify V-01)

items.name: contact and lumped conductances
items.form: Q = h_c * A_c * (T_j - T_i) for a registered joint (h_c record with its temperature range), or Q = G_ij * (T_j - T_i) for a registered measured assembly conductance (isolators, feed tube, straps, brackets). Composite paths in series use registered massless nodes, so no series formula approximates a temperature-dependent path.
items.source: thermal contact resistance: Incropera & DeWitt ch. 3 (verify V-01)

items.name: radiative exchange: gray, diffuse, opaque surfaces in the IR band (net-radiation / radiosity method)
items.form: for every enclosure e and surface k in e: J_k = eps_k sigma T_k^4 + (1 - eps_k) G_k, G_k = sum_l F_kl J_l; net emitted power q_k = A_k eps_k (sigma T_k^4 - G_k); Q_rad,i = - sum over surfaces k of node i of q_k. SPACE (flight) or B_FACILITY (bench) is a black surface with J = sigma T_sink^4. Input checks: summation sum_l F_kl = 1 and reciprocity A_k F_kl = A_l F_lk (D-07, AL-07). The q_k form stays valid for eps_k = 1 (no division by 1 - eps_k). Equivalent script-F exchange factors may be reported.
items.rules: an opening (channel exit, ICP bore) is not a surface: surfaces that see each other through it belong to one enclosure; view factors are registered inputs from a producer (closed forms, or K-P3-RAYS under its own parity contract)
items.source: Modest, Radiative Heat Transfer (net radiation method) (verify V-02); Siegel & Howell, Thermal Radiation Heat Transfer (verify V-03); configuration factors: Howell catalog, registered EXT-HOWELL-CATALOG entries C-40, C-41, C-52, C-77, C-80, C-81 (CX-04)

items.name: environment loads per external surface s
items.form: Q_sol,s = alpha_s * S(t) * A_s * F_sun,s(t) * nu(t); Q_alb,s = alpha_s * a(t) * S(t) * A_s * F_alb,s(t); Q_ir,s = eps_s * q_OLR(t) * A_s * F_earth,s(t); Q_aero,s = alpha_E,s * 0.5 * rho * V_rel^3 * A_ram,s; Q_env,i = sum over external surfaces of node i
items.inputs: alpha_s solar-band absorptance, eps_s IR-band emittance (two-band gray); S, a, q_OLR registered hot / cold values (candidate primary source NASA/TM-2001-211221, registered EXT-NASA-TM2001 sha256 a6ea8902b65e59ef3932d1a1f84c5b3a45938f240344b1d8a7465e79a625467e; applicability verify V-09); nu(t) illumination function and F_sun / F_alb / F_earth from SC-WP-09 orbit and the registered attitude / geometry; rho and V_rel from the frozen atmosphere / design states (SC-WP-01); alpha_E energy accommodation (registered)
items.source: absorbed-flux formulation: Gilmore (ed.), Spacecraft Thermal Control Handbook, Vol. I (verify V-05); free-molecular hyperthermal heating 0.5 rho V^3 alpha_E: Schaaf & Chambre, Flow of Rarefied Gases, or Bird, Molecular Gas Dynamics (verify V-06)
items.note: emission of external surfaces goes to SPACE through E-05; Earth IR and albedo enter only as absorbed fluxes (standard external-flux approximation, verify V-05)

items.name: interface deposition
items.form: Q_src,i = sum over interface keys of w_key,i * Q_key; for every key: sum_i w_key,i + w_key,EXPORT + w_key,BOUNDARY = 1 exactly
items.rule: the weights w are registered inputs, or predicted by the producer and passed in the interface record; a key with a missing weight set is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; weights are never fitted inside this model

items.name: boundary conditions
items.form: SCI-A: Q_bc = G_sc,a (T_sc - T_a); SCI-B: Q_bc = q_sc,a(t) prescribed; SCI-C: spacecraft surfaces as enclosure members at registered T and eps; B_PPU_RF / B_FEED optional links: Q_bc = G_b,i (T_b - T_i)

items.name: electromagnet winding load
items.form: FIXED_POWER mode: Q_coil = registered Q_hall_coil_X_W (steady or ZOH series). CONSTANT_CURRENT_R_OF_T mode: Q_coil = I^2 * R_ref * r(T) / r(T_ref), r from the registered copper resistivity relation inside its domain; evaluation outside the relation's domain gives OUT_OF_DOMAIN (no extrapolation)
items.source: registered relation copper_linear_resistance (NBS Handbook 100, pp. 3-4) and the Roeser ratio table in schemas/thermal_life/limits_v1.json (CX-10)

items.name: steady-state solution
items.form: Newton-Raphson on R(T) = 0 (R_i = right-hand side of E-02) with the analytic Jacobian; backtracking line search on ||R||_2 (numerical aid only; the converged state is independent of it); stopping per NUM-01

items.name: transient integration
items.form: implicit Euler on the enthalpy form: H_i(T_i^{n+1}) - H_i(T_i^n) = dt_n * RHS_i(t_{n+1}, T^{n+1}); every breakpoint of every registered time series is a step boundary and sources are zero-order-hold step values, so the input energy per step is exact; Newton per step (NUM-03); step control per NUM-04 / CONS-T2; formal order p = 1

items.name: orbit handling
items.form: ORBIT_TRANSIENT_PERIODIC: E-11 over repeated orbits with time-resolved nu(t) and loads until CONS-T3; reports T_i(t) and per-orbit raw min / max / mean. ORBIT_AVERAGE_STEADY: E-02 with orbit-averaged loads (integral of load over the orbit divided by the period); reported as an orbit-mean-load steady state, never as the time mean or the extremes of the periodic solution (T^4 nonlinearity)

items.name: interface-derived raw quantities
items.form: Sigma_dep,H = Q_hall_anode_W + Q_hall_wall_inner_W + Q_hall_wall_outer_W + Q_hall_pole_W + (1 - w_EXPORT) Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W + Q_hall_return_to_icp_W; P_hall_exported_W = P_hall_discharge_W - Sigma_dep,H - Q_hall_plume_to_icp_W; P_hall_unattributed_W = P_hall_discharge_W - P_hall_jet_W - Sigma_dep,H; Sigma_I = Q_icp_plasma_wall_W + Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W + Q_icp_match_W + Q_icp_extraction_W + Q_icp_radiation_W; Q_icp_boundary_W = P_icp_bus_W - Sigma_I
items.rule: these quantities are reported raw; P_hall_unattributed_W is deposited on no node by default (OQ-NPT-09)

items.name: global energy statement
items.form: sum_i dH_i/dt = sum of deposited interface heat + sum Q_tc + sum Q_env - net radiation to SPACE (or B_FACILITY) - sum Q to B_SC - sum Q to B_PPU_RF links - sum Q to B_FEED links

link_types.rule: Conduction exists only where a link is registered; the topology record is the complete declaration and is hashed. Radiation-only paths are pairs that share an enclosure but no registered solid link (for example the anode and channel walls across the channel, coil-to-pole gaps that are not bonded, the H-1 front faces and the ICP, the vessel and an unbonded antenna). Whether a given pair is radiation-only is a design registration, never a default.

heat_sources.HS-00_energy_source_rule: Each watt enters the model through the interface of the supply that powers it. Hall discharge supply -> IF-HALL-THERMAL-v1 discharge keys (including the discharge-current return heating at the neutralizer and Hall-plume interception on it). Hall magnet supplies -> IF-HALL-THERMAL-v1 coil keys. RF/ICP chain (generator, line, match, antenna, ICP plasma, collector bias) -> IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1. Thermal-control dissipation -> Q_thermal_control_W. Environment -> ENV inputs. No watt enters twice; the model creates no watt.

record_fields: partitions {key: {receiving id: weight}} (when the producer predicts them)

energy_boundaries.inside: The control volume holds the solid parts of the Hall thruster body (anode, channel walls, pole pieces, magnetic circuit, back plate, coils), the RF/ICP neutralizer module (vessel, antenna, collector, housing, co-located match, mounting structure), the dedicated radiators and every registered link between them.

energy_boundaries.outside: Outside the volume: the Hall discharge plasma and the ICP plasma (their physics stays in HallThruster.jl and NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER; they enter only as interface keys); the plume and beam; the PPU and RF generator (B_PPU_RF); the spacecraft (B_SC); the upstream chain (intake, filter, compressor, plenum, valves, Xe tank: SC-WP-02; only registered B_FEED links); the environment (ENV, SPACE).

energy_boundaries.crossing_terms: In: deposited interface heat, Q_thermal_control_W, absorbed environment, inflow through boundary links. Out: net radiation to SPACE / B_FACILITY, conduction to B_SC / B_PPU_RF / B_FEED. Exported, never deposited: P_hall_exported_W (incl. the jet), Q_icp_extraction_W, the EXPORT shares of Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W and Q_icp_radiation_W. Booked at the boundary, not solved: Q_icp_boundary_W, Q_icp_match_W when not co-located, supply losses declared by producers.

assumptions.text: Nodes are isothermal lumped bodies; validity is checked by the Biot criterion (D-02).

Surfaces are opaque, gray and diffuse in the IR band. Environment absorption uses the solar-band absorptance; IR absorption and emission use the IR-band emittance (two-band treatment, verify V-05, V-15). Room-temperature emittance data are usable only inside their registered temperature range.
The Hall channel plasma and the ICP plasma are transparent in the IR enclosure. Their optical emission enters only as interface source terms with registered partitions (verify V-17).
No convection and no gas conduction (orbit vacuum; bench facility at registered high vacuum, D-04). Propellant enthalpy flow through the anode and the ICP vessel is neglected in v1.
Exported power (plume, beam, extracted electrons, escaping plasma radiation) is not re-deposited on H-1, ICP or spacecraft surfaces, except through the registered key Q_hall_plume_to_icp_W.
Interface heat values are taken as given. The thermal model never re-derives plasma physics and never fits a plasma quantity.
Time-varying inputs are zero-order-hold series with registered breakpoints.

Properties of a node are evaluated at the node temperature. A Kirchhoff-transformed link takes the two node temperatures as its end temperatures; this is exact for the link and an approximation of lumping.
No thermostat or control law in v1: Q_thermal_control_W is a registered schedule.
Passive thermal architecture only (ICD ICP-38 'passive (proposed)'). The bus variant active_cooling gives OUT_OF_DOMAIN.
Geometry is fixed: view factors are registered inputs with no thermal distortion. An opening is not a surface.
Eclipse (umbra / penumbra), Earth-IR and albedo factors come from SC-WP-09 and the registered attitude; the model computes no orbit geometry.
The deep-space sink temperature T_space is a registered input (OQ-NPT-07).
Electrical isolation hardware enters only through registered conductances. The only electro-thermal coupling inside the model is the coil R(T) of E-09.
Contact conductances are temperature-independent unless the registered record states a temperature dependence.

Material and surface properties are those of the registered record. Ageing, atomic-oxygen exposure, sputter deposits and erosion are not modelled (SC-WP-08 owns them); end-of-life property sets are registered case inputs.
DC magnet fields cause no eddy heating. RF induced heating in conductive parts enters only through the Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W partition.

domains.rule: Every property record carries [T_min, T_max]. An evaluation outside it gives OUT_OF_DOMAIN. There is no extrapolation and no clamping.

Bi_i = h_eff,i * L_c,i / k_i <= 0.1, with L_c,i = V_i / A_s,i and h_eff,i = (sum of link conductances of node i + sum over its radiating surfaces of 4 eps sigma T_i^3 A) / A_s,i, evaluated at the solution. Violation gives OUT_OF_DOMAIN with the node id; the remedy is a registered subdivision (refinement_rule). Threshold source: Incropera & DeWitt (verify V-01). SYNTHETIC_VERIFICATION cases are exempt and labelled BIOT_NOT_APPLICABLE_SYNTHETIC.
eps / alpha records must cover the node temperatures (D-01). A record flagged non-gray inside a band is refused unless a two-band split is registered.
BENCH_REPLICA cases register the facility pressure and, before any data, the criterion under which A-04 holds for that facility. Otherwise OUT_OF_DOMAIN.

Configuration hall_icp_neutralizer. supply_mode in {AIR_PRIMARY, XE_CONTINGENCY, NON_FIRING} for FLIGHT_CONDITIONAL; bench gases (e.g. BENCH_AR_ENGINEERING_GROUND_ONLY, N2) only in BENCH_REPLICA. Design state in design_states_v2 (180-230 km, 196 states). Variants active_cooling and icp_assist_magnet are outside v1. Otherwise OUT_OF_DOMAIN.
A key with status OUT_OF_DOMAIN propagates OUT_OF_DOMAIN; with NOT_EVALUATED, NOT_EVALUATED.

Every solved node has a conduction or radiation path to a sink or boundary, else MODEL_ERROR (floating node). Each enclosure satisfies |sum_l F_kl - 1| <= 1e-9 for every k and |A_k F_kl - A_l F_lk| <= 1e-9 * max(A_k F_kl, A_l F_lk) for every pair, else MODEL_ERROR; symmetrization is the producer's registered step, never silent here.

Peak and minimum temperatures come only from TRANSIENT or ORBIT_TRANSIENT_PERIODIC runs. ORBIT_AVERAGE_STEADY yields orbit-mean-load temperatures only (E-12). The ratio of the largest node time constant to the orbit period is reported raw.
There is no global range; the valid range of a run is the intersection of the property validity ranges it uses (D-01).

numerics.rule: Steady Newton stops when CONS-S1 and CONS-S2 hold and the last max |dT| <= 1e-8 K. Cap: 100 iterations, then MODEL_ERROR.
The initial guess is the registered case input T_init (no hidden default).

Per transient step: Newton stops when the last max |dT| <= 1e-9 K (quadratic convergence leaves a round-off-level step residual); stored energy is evaluated relative to the initial state to limit round-off. Cap: 50 iterations, then the step is halved. CONS-T1 is the gate on the accumulated result.
Step control by step doubling against CONS-T2. Cap: 20 successive halvings of a step, then MODEL_ERROR. The step sequence is deterministic.
Periodic orbits: at most 200 orbits to meet CONS-T3, then MODEL_ERROR.
IEEE-754 binary64. Reductions run in registered node-id order. No result depends on thread count.
Linear solves: dense LU with partial pivoting (the network is small).

numerics.definition: Q_scale = sum_i |Q_src,i| + sum_i |Q_tc,i| + sum_s |Q_env,s| + sum_b |Q_bc,b| + sum over external surfaces of |net radiation to the sink|, at the evaluated state.
eps_if = 1e-6 * (reference power of the identity) + 1e-9 W; the reference is P_hall_discharge_W for IFH-3 / IFH-4, P_icp_bus_W for IFI-3 / IFI-4 and P_icp_rf_forward_W for IFI-5.

conservation.name: steady per-node residual
conservation.criterion: |R_i| <= 1e-9 * Q_scale + 1e-9 W for every solved node

conservation.name: steady global balance
conservation.criterion: |sum of deposited interface heat + sum Q_tc + sum Q_env - net radiation to the sink - sum boundary outflows| <= 1e-9 * Q_scale + 1e-9 W

conservation.name: transient energy integral (stored energy change = integrated net heat)
conservation.criterion: for every step and cumulatively from t0: |dH_total - sum_n dt_n * Q_net,n| <= 1e-8 * max(sum_n dt_n * Q_abs,n, |dH_total|) + 1e-6 J, with dH_total = sum_i (H_i(T_i(t)) - H_i(T_i(t0))) evaluated exactly from the registered c_p forms and Q_net,n the scheme-consistent net inflow of step n (Q_abs,n the sum of magnitudes)

conservation.name: time-step refinement
conservation.criterion: max over nodes and accepted output times of |T_dt - T_dt/2| <= 1e-2 K; the value is reported as u_num,t

conservation.name: periodic steady state
conservation.criterion: max over nodes and orbit phase of |T_i(t + P) - T_i(t)| <= 1e-3 K

conservation.name: interface identities
conservation.criterion: IFH-3, IFH-4, IFI-3, IFI-4, IFI-5 with eps_if (NUM-09)

conservation.name: deposition bookkeeping
conservation.criterion: sum over keys of (deposited + exported + boundary-booked) = sum of interface key inputs, within 1e-12 relative + 1e-12 W (E-07 weights sum to 1)

conservation.name: system energy ledger (CLAUDE.md rule 4)
conservation.criterion: the thermal model's booked flows reconcile with the SC-WP-05 bus ledger in the system energy-ledger check with residual < 2 %; evaluated by that system check, not inside the thermal equations

analytic_limiting_cases.rule: Software verification criteria for the Rust implementation (CI_PLAN principle 9). They are not model outputs and not gate statuses. Every vector is SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE. sigma = 5.670374419e-8 W m^-2 K^-4. Every case must also meet the CONS criteria that apply to it.

cases.setup: one node, one external surface (area A, emittance eps, F = 1 to SPACE at T_s), constant load Q, steady
node 1 with load Q, LUMPED_G link G1 to node 2, LUMPED_G link G2 from node 2 to a fixed boundary T_b, no radiation, steady
cases.closed_form: T2 = T_b + Q / G2; T1 = T2 + Q / G1 (series resistance 1/G1 + 1/G2); both link flows = Q
cases.pass_criterion: |dT| <= 1e-6 K at both nodes; |link flow - Q| <= 1e-9 * Q + 1e-9 W

cases.setup: node with load Q, CONDUCTION link of shape factor S to a boundary T_b = T0, k(T) = k0 (1 + beta (T - T0)), steady
cases.closed_form: x = T1 - T0; Q = S k0 (x + beta x^2 / 2); x = Q / (S k0) for beta = 0, else x = (-1 + sqrt(1 + 2 beta Q / (S k0))) / beta

cases.setup: node of constant capacity C, LUMPED_G link G to boundary T_b, initial T0, step load Q at t = 0, integrate to 10 tau
cases.closed_form: T(t) = T_inf + (T0 - T_inf) exp(-t / tau), T_inf = T_b + Q / G, tau = C / G
cases.pass_criterion: (a) with dt = tau / 1000: max over t of |T - T_exact| <= 1e-3 * |T_inf - T0|; (b) observed order p_obs = log2(e(dt) / e(dt / 2)) with dt = tau / 100 satisfies |p_obs - 1| <= 0.1; (c) CONS-T1 at every step

cases.setup: closed enclosure of two gray surfaces with F11 = 1 - F12, F12 and A1 / A2 given; (a) both temperatures prescribed; (b) surface 1 on a node with load Q, surface 2 on a fixed boundary T2
cases.closed_form: Q12 = sigma (T1^4 - T2^4) / ((1 - eps1) / (eps1 A1) + 1 / (A1 F12) + (1 - eps2) / (eps2 A2)); concentric cylinders / parallel plates: F12 = 1; sphere patches: F12 = A2 / (A1 + A2)

geometry: sphere split into two patches, A1 = 0.1 m2, A2 in {0.1, 0.4} m2, F12 = A2 / (A1 + A2)

cases.source: general two-surface enclosure formula (Incropera & DeWitt ch. 13, verify V-01); spherical-enclosure view factor F_ij = A_j / A_total (verify V-18)
cases.pass_criterion: (a) |Q12 - exact| <= 1e-9 * |exact| + 1e-12 W; (b) |T1 - T1_exact| <= 1e-6 K, with T1_exact = (Q R_tot / sigma + T2^4)^(1/4) and R_tot the denominator above

cases.closed_form: T_i = T_s for every node; every link flow = 0

comparison_criteria.rule: Comparison quantities are the registered sensor temperatures and calorimetric heat flows (P3-C-03).

Comparison error E_q = S_q - D_q (simulation minus data). Validation uncertainty u_val,q = sqrt(u_num^2 + u_input^2 + u_D^2) at one standard uncertainty: u_num from CONS-T2 and the steady tolerance, u_input from propagating the registered input uncertainties, u_D from the registered sensor uncertainty incl. placement / contact (P3-C-02, P3-C-05). Source: ASME V&V 20-2009 (verify V-07).
A quantity is CONSISTENT if |E_q| <= 2 * u_val,q (coverage factor 2; JCGM 100:2008, verify V-08), else INCONSISTENT.
The owner residual band (P3-C-04, TBD) must also hold. Until it is registered, the validation outcome is NOT_EVALUATED.

If two sensors on one node differ by more than 2 * sqrt(u_D1^2 + u_D2^2), the node has an UNREPRESENTED_GRADIENT. Per A9.12 P3Q-02, a finer multi-node model (a new prereg version) is then required before any LOCK-1 thermal closure.

Dataset outcome: VALIDATED_WITHIN_TESTED_DOMAIN if every quantity is CONSISTENT, VC-04 holds and VC-05 raises no gradient; VALIDATION_INCONSISTENT if any quantity is INCONSISTENT (permanent for that dataset); NOT_EVALUATED otherwise. The validated domain is the tested operating envelope only.
